slides.title: Who does Ethiopia blame in Tigray?
Army chief's claim
slides.body: Ethiopia says Eritrea led a military push in Tigray with the TPLF (Al Jazeera).

slides.title: Egypt is named too
slides.body: Ethiopia says Egypt gave logistical support. Not independently verified.

slides.title: Replies so far
slides.body: Al Jazeera reports no Egypt or Eritrea comment. Eritrea rejected earlier accusations on Nov 12.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Choose dialogue.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
